notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three enchantments.
description:
Declare Magus of the Candelabra as an attacker.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding {W} for each enchantment you control.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and Serra's Sanctum.
Repeat from step 2.
